# Bluebook Quick Patterns (21st ed. default)

Use these as starting forms. Always verify against the actual source and the current Bluebook or the court’s local citation rule.

## Cases
- Full: *Case Name*, Vol Reporter Page, Pin (Court Year).
- Example: *Brady v. Maryland*, 373 U.S. 83, 87 (1963).
- Short form (after full cite): *Brady*, 373 U.S. at 87.
- Id. when the immediately preceding cite is the same source and the pin is the same or adjacent.

## Statutes
- U.S. Code: 42 U.S.C. § 1983 (2018).
- State: N.C. Gen. Stat. § 15A-974 (2023).
- Note the year of the code or the supplement.

## Rules
- Fed. R. Crim. P. 12(b)(3).
- N.C. R. Evid. 403.
- Local rules: cite the court’s local rule number and, if needed, the effective date.

## Constitutions
- U.S. Const. amend. IV.
- N.C. Const. art. I, § 19.

## Record and Transcripts (matter convention preferred)
- (Tr. 42:15–18)
- (Aff. ¶ 7)
- (Ex. 3 at 2)
Do not force full Bluebook form on record cites unless the court requires it.

## Signals and Flags
- [PIN UNVERIFIED] — claimed page not confirmed in available source.
- [AUTH UNVERIFIED] — not yet in the reliance-approved ledger.
- [INCOMPLETE] — missing volume, reporter, page, court, or year.

## Short-Form Reminders
- Introduce the full cite once.
- Use *Id.* only for the immediately preceding authority.
- Use the short form (*Name*, Vol at Pin) for later cites to the same case.
